shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/schematic rows
rows of repeated vertical elements (crew strokes / columns and figure files)
processional line of figures moving in one direction
justification: Both surfaces stack horizontal registers containing files of repeated upright human figures moving in a common direction, and both include quadrupeds in profile, which gives a loose arrangement echo. But A is a stick-figure, outline-only rock-art idiom dominated by boats with crew strokes and tiny abstract figures, while B is a naturalistic architectural relief scene with modelled robed guards, staircases, columns and a bull attacked by a lion — the specific motifs and drawing conventions share nothing distinctive.
